svg.aria-label: Missing west wings with W on its own axis, at v = 0.45, d = 0.72: (a) S on the south side of C, s = 0, in the smallest disk that allows these separations (radius 1.696), with the weights 41/20, 3/2, 1, 1; (b) S on its own axis, s = 0.2, radius 1.700, with the weights 41/20, 2, 1, 1. The forces on D come from the secondary axes of D and of S. (c) The domain of (v, d) left by Proposition D.7, shaded by the minimum over s of the profiles of both cases, with the three points of Lemma D.18 and the smallest lower bounds there of Tables D.12 and D.13
